questions.question: To provide proof of conformity of an aircraft product, the mechanic must start with what document?
questions.idealAnswer: Type Certificate Data Sheet.

questions.question: What needs to be performed to prepare an aircraft for an annual or 100-hour inspection?
questions.idealAnswer: Remove or open all necessary inspection plates, access doors, fairings, and cowlings. Then thoroughly clean the aircraft and the engine.

concepts.label: Remove or open all necessary inspection plates
terms: remove or open all necessary inspection plates

concepts.label: cowlings. Then thoroughly clean the aircraft
terms: cowlings. then thoroughly clean the aircraft

questions.question: What is the difference between an annual and 100 -hour inspection?
questions.idealAnswer: Except for the difference in time between inspections and the person who can sign it off, there is no difference between the annual and the 100-hour inspection. They are identical in scope and detail.

concepts.label: Except for the difference in time between inspections
terms: except for the difference in time between inspections

concepts.label: the person who can sign it off
terms: the person who can sign it off

concepts.label: there is no difference between the annual
terms: there is no difference between the annual

concepts.label: the 100-hour inspection. They are identical in scope
terms: the 100-hour inspection. they are identical in scope

questions.question: Who has the authority to sign off and return to service a 100-hour inspection?
questions.idealAnswer: An appropriately rated mechanic may return an aircraft to service after a 100-hour inspection. (A&P mechanic.)

questions.question: What are the operating conditions which make the 100-hour inspection mandatory?
questions.idealAnswer: The 100-hour inspection is required for aircraft that carry persons for hire or is used to give flight instruction for hire.

questions.question: Where can you find a checklist for the 100-hour inspection?
questions.idealAnswer: 14 CFR Part 43, Appendix D.

questions.question: Where would you find the recommended statement for recording the approval or disapproval for return to service of an aircraft after a 100-hour inspection?
questions.idealAnswer: 14 CFR Part 43.11.

questions.question: Who can approve an aircraft for return to service after an annual inspection.
questions.idealAnswer: An A&P mechanic who holds an Inspection Authorization (IA) certificate.

questions.question: Who can approve an aircraft for return to service after a progressive inspection has been performed?
questions.idealAnswer: A certified mechanic holding an Inspection Authorization, the aircraft manufacturer, or a certified repair station.

concepts.label: A certified mechanic holding an Inspection Authorization
terms: a certified mechanic holding an inspection authorization

questions.question: What is the maximum time that a 100-hour inspection may be extended?
questions.idealAnswer: No more than 10 hours. The 10 hours may only be used to ferry the aircraft to the next inspection site.

questions.question: What do you need to fly an aircraft past its annual date?
questions.idealAnswer: You must obtain a Ferry Permit.

questions.question: What do you check for when inspecting floats on an airplane?
questions.idealAnswer: Check for corrosion and leaks.

questions.question: What condition of an aircraft seat belt would determine it to be unserviceable?
questions.idealAnswer: A seat belt that has frayed is considered unserviceable.

questions.question: Name some places where a list of life limited parts may be found.
questions.idealAnswer: Type certificate data sheets, Airworthiness limitations

questions.question: What types of damage may be found when inspecting compressor blades?
questions.idealAnswer: Scratches, dents, galling, gouges, burrs, burns, pitting, cracks.

questions.question: What should you do before washing an aircraft?
questions.idealAnswer: Ensure static ports and pitot tubes are covered and ensure all panels and doors are closed/installed.

questions.question: What must the mechanic furnish to the owner or operator of an aircraft, if the aircraft had a 100-hour inspection and is determined to be unairworthy?
questions.idealAnswer: A signed and dated list of all the discrepancies that keep it from being airworthy . Along with a statement ( " I certify that this aircraft has been inspected in accordance with a 100hr inspection and a list of discrepancies and unworthy items have been provided to the aircraft owner/operator".) Sign, date and A&P number.

concepts.label: dated list of all the discrepancies that keep it from being airworthy . Along with a state
terms: dated list of all the discrepancies that keep it from being airworthy . along with a statement sign

questions.question: What is the difference between an annual and a 100-hour?
questions.idealAnswer: Annuals must be done by A&P I/A (Inspection Authorization) . 100-hour can be done by A&P. The actual inspections are of the same scope and detail. They are identical.

concepts.label: Annuals must be done by A&P I/A . 100-hour can be done by A&P. The actual inspections are
terms: annuals must be done by a&p i/a . 100-hour can be done by a&p. the actual inspections are of the same scope

questions.question: Does the FAA require a checklist be used when conducting annuals or 100-hours?
questions.idealAnswer: Yes, under 14 CFR 43.15 (C) (1)

questions.question: Where can you find requirements for altimeter and static system inspections operated under IFR?
questions.idealAnswer: 14 CFR 43 Appendix E ( 91.411 has altimeter and encoder checks operating governing rules.

questions.question: What certification is required for a mechanic to conduct a progressive inspection?
questions.idealAnswer: An A&P I/A, or, an A&P under supervision of an IA.

concepts.label: an A&P under supervision of an IA
terms: an a&p under supervision of an ia

questions.question: Where can you find requirements for ATC Transponder inspections?
questions.idealAnswer: 14 CFR 43 Appendix F ( 91.413 has transponder check operating governing rules.)

questions.question: Where do you find the regulation that specifies the operating conditions that make 100-hour inspections mandatory?
questions.idealAnswer: FAR Part 91

questions.question: What is the timeframe within which an annual inspection must be performed if it is required?
questions.idealAnswer: Within the preceding 12 calendar months.

questions.question: Under what conditions may any checklist be used as a guide for a 100-hour inspection?
questions.idealAnswer: The checklist must meet the minimum standards in 43 Appendix D, if it does, it can be used.

concepts.label: The checklist must meet the minimum standards in 43 Appendix D
terms: the checklist must meet the minimum standards in 43 appendix d

questions.question: An aircraft under a progressive inspection program is operated for compensation or hire. Does it need a 100-hour inspection?
questions.idealAnswer: No, Progressive inspections replace 100-hour inspections.

questions.question: Who is authorized to supervise a progressive inspection?
questions.idealAnswer: A&P/IA, certified repair stations, or the manufacturer.

questions.question: When a progressive inspection program is discontinued, at what time is the next 100-hour inspection due?
questions.idealAnswer: 100 hours after the last complete inspection of the progressive program.

questions.question: If an owner desires to use a progressive inspection program. Who does the owner apply for authorization?
questions.idealAnswer: The local FAA (FSDO) Flight Standard District Office.

questions.question: Is an engine run up required as part of a 100-hour inspection on a turbine powered aircraft?
questions.idealAnswer: Yes, under FAR 43.15(c)

questions.question: Where would you locate the required items that must be recorded in the aircraft maintenance records following completion of a 100-hour inspection?
questions.idealAnswer: FAR Part 43.

questions.question: Where would you look to find approved information for working on an aircraft electrical system?
questions.idealAnswer: The AMM or other instructions for continued airworthiness.

questions.question: What are the limitations placed on mechanics with regards to propellers?
questions.idealAnswer: Mechanics may not perform major repairs or alterations of propellers.

questions.question: After equipment is installed in accordance with an STC who must approve the return to service?
questions.idealAnswer: An A&P holding an IA.
